name: Incline Cable Overhead Tricep Extension
description: The incline cable overhead extension is performed lying on an incline bench facing away from a low cable, with the arms raised overhead to extend the triceps against the cable's resistance. The incline provides back support and positions the arms at an angle that creates an extended stretch on the tricep long head throughout the movement. The cable maintains constant tension unlike free weight incline overhead extensions.

execution.starting_position: Set an incline bench in front of a low cable pulley, facing away. Lie back on the incline. Hold a rope or straight bar attached to the cable with arms overhead.
execution.setup_instructions: Place the bench close to the pulley so the cable runs overhead without interference. Incline at 45 degrees.
steps: Step 1: Begin with elbows bent, hands near the head, feeling the tricep stretch.
Step 2: Extend the elbows to straighten the arms overhead.
Step 3: Hold the locked-out position briefly.
Step 4: Return with control to the starting stretched position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on extension, inhale on return.
common_mistakes: Bench not positioned close enough to the cable (causes awkward pull angle)
safety_considerations: Ensure the bench is stable and the cable path is clear
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full elbow flexion with overhead stretch to full extension.
coaching_cues: Stretch at the bottom — savor it
